scoring_justification: Predicted bulk moduli are recomputed from the agent's fitted power-law parameters and the supplied compound data, then compared against paper's experimental bulk moduli (relative tolerance 20%). The fitted parameters themselves are compared to paper gold (T0) because the exact fitting subset is not fully deterministic from the public description.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported power-law parameters (m, C) for five bonding groups (Table 3) and experimental bulk moduli for 10 compounds (Table 4).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's tables; no synthesis.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own published experimental data and fitted parameters, traceable to the paper.

outputs.description: Fitted power-law exponent m and preterm C for each of the five bonding-mode groups.
Predicted bulk moduli (GPa) for the listed AB compounds, computed via geometric-mean formula using the fitted group parameters.

output_contract.notes: All scoring uses hidden paper-reported reference values. The instruction provides the required interatomic distances and classification table; no external datasets need to be fetched.

steps.description: Compare agent's fitted m and C for each of the five bonding groups against paper-reported gold values with tolerances (|Δm| ≤ 0.01, |ΔC| ≤ 0.001).

Recompute predicted bulk moduli from agent's fitted parameters (step_01_fitted_parameters.csv) using the provided compound list and geometric-mean formula, then compare to hidden experimental bulk moduli (relative error ≤ 20% scores 1, partial credit beyond).
